# Text to speech

Generated by BootAgent. It calls `tts-1` on the user's local account. BootAgent rewrites this Skill when the model or Provider changes, so do not edit it.

## When to use

When the user asks you to turn text into spoken audio: reading out a summary, producing a voice-over draft.

## Command

Run the script from the user's working directory, using the absolute path to this Skill:

```bash
node <this Skill's directory>/scripts/run.mjs speak --text "<text>" [--voice <name>] [--format mp3|wav|opus|aac|flac|pcm] [--out <file or directory>]
```

- `--text`: what to say, at most 4096 characters. Split longer text into several runs.
- `--voice`: the voice name. Default `alloy`; other models may name their voices differently, and the Provider's error says so.
- `--format`: audio format. Default `mp3`.
- `--out`: a file path, or a directory. Default `~/.bootagent/output`, outside the Skill directory.
- `--timeout`: seconds to wait. Default 120.

The saved file path is printed to stdout. Existing files are never overwritten.

## Rules

- Every run costs money, billed by the length of the text. Before each run, tell the user what text you are about to speak and wait for them to agree.
- Never print, echo or log environment variables, `~/.bootagent/skill-env/local.env`, or anything that could reveal the API key. The script reads the key itself; you never need it.
- Only send files the user asked about. They go to the user's own Provider and nowhere else.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning | What to tell the user |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Success | Report the result. |
| 2 | Bad arguments or input file | Fix the command, or ask the user for the right file. |
| 3 | Setup problem: Node.js older than 18, or no API key found | Ask the user to restart the Agent so it picks up `BOOTAGENT_LOCAL_API_KEY`, or to reinstall this Skill from BootAgent. |
| 4 | The Provider refused the request | Show the Provider's message. The model may not support this input; the user can choose another model in BootAgent. |
| 5 | The Provider rejected the API key | Ask the user to check the local key in BootAgent. |
| 6 | The Provider was unreachable, busy or timed out | Suggest trying again later. |

`node <this Skill's directory>/scripts/run.mjs check` confirms the key is available without sending a request.
